text: Approved refunds are processed within five business days. Refunds above 5,000 EUR require a second approver from the finance team before processing begins.
A credit note always references the invoice it offsets. Credit note INV-88231 was issued in March 2026 against invoice INV-88102, which was dated 19 February 2026.
Suppliers may charge a late fee of 2 percent per month on overdue balances. Late fees are recorded against the original invoice, never as a separate invoice.
ERR-4021 is raised when the payment gateway times out after 30 seconds. The payment is not retried automatically; an operator must confirm the charge did not land before resubmitting.
ERR-4090 means the supplier bank rejected the transfer. The transfer is cancelled and the invoice returns to the approval queue.
Gateway incidents lasting more than 15 minutes are escalated to the payments on-call engineer, who owns the decision to fail over to the backup provider.
Every payment above 10,000 EUR needs two approvers. Approvals are recorded in the audit log with the approver identity and a timestamp.
Invoices and their audit trails are retained for ten years. Retention is enforced by the archive job, which runs nightly and writes to cold storage.
Invoices are stored in the currency they were issued in. Reporting converts to EUR using the rate on the invoice date, not the payment date.
A new supplier is onboarded once tax details and bank details are verified independently. Bank details changed after onboarding require a call-back to a known contact.
